recentItems.title: Drawing the Circle Wider: Bringing Instrumentalists into Choir | Dr. Joshua Cheney, presenter
recentItems.description:
Some of our strongest choral recruits come from the band or orchestra room, but transitioning from an instrument to the voice can be a daunting shift for many students. This session offers a practical roadmap for successfully integrating instrumentalists into your choir. We will discuss effective recruitment strategies, how to bridge the gap between their instrumental technique and vocal production, and explore how to connect them with choral text. Join us to discover how to turn talented players into confident, engaged singers who elevate the leadership and skill level of your entire ensemble.

This interactive session invites music educators to experience a brain-based, inclusive approach to drumming that transforms classroom management, engagement, and student ownership through joyful music-making. Participants will explore foundational grooves, rhythmic games, simple conducting cues, and facilitation tools that support focus, collaboration, and creativity. Through hands-on activities, educators learn how to create safe, supportive environments where all students feel seen, heard, and successful. The session integrates neuroscience, movement, voice, drums, ukulele, Boomwhackers, and Orff instruments to demonstrate accessible “ways in” for all ages and abilities. Participants leave empowered with practical strategies for fostering collective music-making, student leadership, and authentic musical expression in any classroom or community setting.
